changelog_behavior_summary.behavior: Resting limit orders fill only after a trade through the limit; a touch does not fill.
Each resting fill is capped by triggering tick volume, rounded down to board lots of 100; zero lot quantity does not fill.
Earlier orders share a tick volume cap in placement order; residual remains open intraday.
Immediate limit fills retain prior timing/price behavior and are subject to tick quantity cap.
Remaining limit quantity is canceled at EOD and does not carry overnight.

changelog_behavior_summary.evidence: CHANGELOG DOCUMENTED; market fill source unchanged

changelog_behavior_summary.behavior: Trade volume caps are tracked per symbol and reduced by team fills already made that day.
One transaction-log row is written per fill; multiple fills for one order share an order number.
All fills for one buy order join one portfolio lot; sell fills can close that lot in pieces.
